name: DeleteRecord
caption: Delete Record

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{FindCustomers_results}}" or "{{trigger_Rec}}". It must resolve to a Reference (RecordId) in the flow context: an undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element, results[0]); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Bare names without braces are rejected.
Run Triggers. true (default when absent) = BC standard OnDelete(true): the table's OnDelete trigger and its subscribers run; false = OnDelete(false). Non-boolean values fall back to the default.

rules.check: configuration.reference must be present and non-empty.
configuration.reference must be a single SmartField placeholder: after trimming it starts with '{{', ends with '}}' and has a non-empty name inside.
The reference must resolve to an existing record reference in the flow context at run time.
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: The referenced record must still exist when the step runs (it is re-read before deletion).
triggers should be a JSON boolean; other types fall back to true.

notes: Unlike the other record steps, Delete Record stores no tableNo: the table comes from the resolved reference, and any table is accepted.
No outputs. Do not reference the deleted record afterwards.
Writing step: a Confirm dialog placed after this step (in document order) produces a publish warning, because Business Central cannot open a dialog once the flow has written to the database.
